H01.description: Header documentation of the new host-mode opt-in.

H03.description: Header documentation of size cap and symlink filtering in the final copy.

H04.description: Header documentation of base tree and snapshot symlink filtering.

H05.description: Header documentation of harness removal, container hardening and output cap.

H06.description: Header documentation of node-path reading, regression parse errors and refactor assertion.

H07.description: Header documentation of bounded, symlink-refusing sandbox reads.

H08.description: Header documentation of refactor verdict accuracy.

H09.description: Header documentation of the contamination scan changes.

H10.description: Header documentation of grade.json schema and version history.

H11.description: Header documentation of self-check green rules.

H12.description: Imports, version bump and constants (harness names, caps, configurable timeout) used by the fixes.

H13.description: remove_path chmods every entry os.walk lists as a directory, including symlinks to directories, so os.chmod follows an agent-planted link and changes the mode of a directory outside the tree.

H14.description: Adds the bounded O_NOFOLLOW read_regular helper and OVERSIZED counter used by the read and size fixes.

H15.description: copy_tree recreates every symlink verbatim, so absolute or tree-escaping links from the agent's sandbox land in the grading tree and let graded commands reach files outside it.

H16.description: A directory symlink is copied with its original target even when absolute or escaping the tree.

H17.description: copy_tree copies regular files of any size (a sparse multi-TB file becomes a dense write) and also recreates escaping file symlinks.

H18.description: Records the structural check's source path for the refactor hidden assertion.

H19.description: Counts the structural check's static cases for the refactor hidden assertion.

H20.description: The pytest argv honours an agent-written ini file's addopts, which can inject plugins or deselect hidden tests.

H21.description: Grading containers run unnamed, without pid/memory/cpu limits, capability drop, init or a kill-after deadline, so a runaway or hung test cannot be bounded or cleaned up.

H22.description: On client timeout the docker client is abandoned without killing the container or its process group, and stdout is captured unbounded in memory.

H23.description: def_line opens whatever path the test output names (absolute, above the tree, a FIFO or /dev/zero), so agent-printed node ids can hang or exhaust the grader.

H24.description: Collection-error expansion reads any agent-printed path without bounds or file-type checks.

H25.description: Caller updated for exec_in_tree's new truncation return value.

H27.description: all_pass ignores the exit status and timeout, so a passing TAP block followed by a non-zero exit (or a timed-out run) counts as green; the fix also adds parse-error-aware regression computation.

H28.description: prepare leaves agent-written conftest.py, ini files and bats helpers/setup_suite in the grading tree, so the agent's code can rewrite test outcomes (e.g. a hookwrapper turning failures into passes).

H29.description: Counter for links dropped from snapshot trees.

H30.description: Snapshot extraction accepts tar members of any size.

H31.description: data_filter judges symlink members in archive order, so a link that escapes only through a later link survives in snapshot trees.

H32.description: Marker object for oversized files in churn.

H33.description: churn reads whole files of any size (and non-regular files) into memory to diff them.

H34.description: Counts oversized files as changed without diffing.

H35.description: gate_verdict follows a symlinked feedback file (or one under a symlinked parent) and reads it unbounded, so a verdict can be taken from outside the sandbox or a FIFO can hang the grader.

H36.description: review_md_verdict follows a symlinked review.md and reads it unbounded.

H37.description: Envelope JSON is read without a size cap or regular-file check.

H38.description: combined_findings reads review/feedback files unbounded and through symlinked parent directories outside the sandbox.

H39.description: Adds HOME_WORD and SENSITIVE patterns used by the contamination fix.

H40.description: In host mode the caller's credential stores (~/.claude, ~/.codex, ~/.aws) are exempt allowed roots, so reads of them are never flagged as contamination.

H41.description: outside() allows /proc/<pid>/environ and similar secrets and /var/run because /proc and /var are allowed roots, and does not treat ~/ paths as outside.

H42.description: The Bash scan never flags ~/ or $HOME/ words and skips every one-component /x/ word as a regex, so `cd /root/` escapes detection.

H43.description: Callers pass the sandbox root to gate_verdict.

H44.description: Caller passes the sandbox root to review_md_verdict.

H45.description: For refactor tasks hidden_tests is the fixture suite rather than the structural check (and the base suite green is from a different run), and regressions with an unparseable base report nothing newly failing.

H46.description: Snapshot trees for refactor tasks are graded with test_command instead of the structural check, so gate verdict accuracy for refactor is computed against the wrong assertion.

H47.description: Records the oversized file count in grade.json.

H48.description: Self-check treats the suite as green from pass counts alone, ignoring exit status, timeout and parse errors.

H49.description: --executor host runs the agent's code unisolated on the host with no opt-in or warning.

H50.description: Header documentation of new schema rules.

H51.description: Usage line range extended because the header grew by two lines.

H52.description: Refuses regression_command on refactor tasks, consistent with the grader's new refactor model.

H53.description: The validator accepts build tasks whose grader_protected omits fixture test files, so the agent can edit the regression suite the grader runs.

H54.description: Test setup opts in to host mode.

H64.description: Test stub accepts new docker flags.

I01.description: The head contamination scan flags ordinary agent text (slash commands like /review-sprint, git log --all in prose/heredocs, sed delimiters) as outside_path or git_history, marking clean runs contaminated.
